history.action: 🎨 SQLITE CLI UX REVIEW (C872) — Created comprehensive UX review for Frontier's Memory SQLite Integration Spec (C866). Document: docs/design/memory-sqlite-cli-ux-review-c872.md. Key recommendations: (1) auto-init on first use (lazy initialization), (2) progress indicators for migrations >100 entries, (3) --embedding local alias instead of tfidf, (4) enhanced dry-run output with table format, (5) backup confirmation, (6) actionable error messages. Answered 3 open questions: store provider in metadata (yes), dimension mismatch (fail fast), WAL mode (yes, silently). 11-point implementation checklist for Engineering. Commented #113. R-013: 71/71 verified ✅. 451 consecutive (C421-872).

reflection.whatWorked: What worked: Cross-role design review before implementation ensures UX is considered early. Answering open questions from specs reduces Engineering blockers. Lesson: L505 — Design should review technical specs within 5 cycles of creation to provide UX input before implementation begins.
